article.title: Israeli forces arrest groom at his wedding in attack on West Bank village
article.author: Aseel Saleh
article.content: The Israeli forces escalated their assaults on the village of Al-Mughayyir in the central occupied West Bank between Wednesday, November 11 and Friday, November 13. On Wednesday, the Israeli military’s bulldozers and excavators razed lands belonging to Palestinian citizens from the village to construct a new settlement road. This came days after bulldozing olive orchards in Al-Mughayyir, which resulted in uprooting about 12,000 trees . One day later, Israeli forces destroyed the martyrs’ memorial in Al-Mughayyir. Meanwhile, on Friday, they raided the house of a Palestinian citizen, forcing him and his family to evacuate after blocking the only entrance to the village. Hours later, Israeli troops stormed a ballroom where a wedding was being held and arrested four Palestinians, including the groom, who was taken to an unknown location. According to local media outlets, roughly 150 invitees, including women, were held inside the ballroom, attacked with tear gas, and searched. Reports indicated that soldiers confiscated some women’s jewelry during the searches, while young men were briefly detained and beaten nearby. On the same evening, the Israeli military raided a school in the village and summoned its director to the scene immediately, with no further details reported about the incident. Al-Mughayyir is among several villages east of Ramallah that have increasingly faced Israeli settler violence, frequent military raids, land bulldozing, and restrictions on movement. These assaults have increased in 2026. Read more: Settler violence escalates in the West Bank. Understand why it is concentrated east of Ramallah At least six Palestinians, including four children and one teenager, have been killed at the hands of illegal Israeli settlers and Israeli forces since the beginning of the year.
